name: card
title: Card
description: One project or one stat: micro-header, title, body, at most one action.

files.content:
CS-017 · 2025Live

Atlas · token pipeline

One source for every surface. 14 months, 3 platforms.

use_it_when: One project or one stat: micro-header, title, body, at most one action.
A concept the reader scans and acts on as one unit.
A list of items, each opening its own page → the row card.
The one item a page leads with → the feature card, once per page.
use_something_else_when: Secondary information shown on demand → Popover or Modal.
A gradient background → never; the surface stays on the obsidian ramp. The light of the feature card is a glow behind the content, not a fill.

rules: Every card carries a micro-header (.card-meta) with project code, date, or index. Mono, --t-micro, --obsidian-400.
At most one action per card, on its own row at the end; it is .btn-primary only when the card is the screen's single primary act.
